methods.description: Convert the rate to a decimal and time to matching periods, then write I=Prn, substitute and calculate.
Calculate simple interest first, then add the principal using A=P+I.
Write I=Prn, substitute known values, simplify and solve for P, r or n; convert a rate to a percentage and time units when asked.

Trace from time to the line then the interest axis, or from interest to the line then the time axis.
